description: List of browser profiles available for management. Shows only those with access allowed by the owner ("API" column). For each — name, whether running, proxy, and note.
name: list_profiles

description: Manager status: version, total profile count, profiles available to agent, and profiles currently running.
name: status

description: Start browser profile. Can open a URL immediately. If profile is already running, the URL will open in its window.
name: start_profile

description: Assign proxy to profile. Format "type://login:password@host:port" or "host:port". Empty string removes proxy.
name: set_proxy

description: Check profile proxy: whether alive and exit location.
name: check_proxy

description: Create new browser profile. Immediately allowed for agent. Proxy, note, and category can be set.
name: create_profile

description: Profile tags: without "tags" shows current ones, with "tags" replaces them entirely.
name: profile_tags

description: Profile note: without fields shows current one, with fields saves it. "title" is a short title visible in the table.
name: profile_note

description: Check proxies for multiple profiles at once. Without a list, checks all available.
name: check_proxies

description: Which open windows are ready for value distribution and what is already assigned to each. Windows without antidetect are shown with a reason.
name: sync_windows

description: Value sets for distribution across windows. Without fields — shows sets (name, line count, how many free). With "name" and "lines" — creates a new set.

lines.description: Values line by line, one per window

name: sync_sets

description: Assign one line from the set to each open window. Inserts nothing — only decides what goes where and returns it. Repeated call does not reassign already assigned values.

profiles.description: Whom to distribute to; defaults to all ready

name: sync_spread

description: Insert into each window ITS value from the set into the field where the cursor is placed in the lead window. Before calling, a human must focus the desired field.

leader.description: Lead window; defaults to the first ready

name: sync_insert

description: Scripts from manager folder: name, runner, and whether runner is available. File contents are not shown.
name: list_scripts

description: Move profile TO TRASH. Data is not deleted: profile is kept intact with cookies and sessions, and can be restored with restore_profile. Running profile is closed first.
name: trash_profile

description: What is in trash: name, when deleted, size.
name: list_trash

description: Restore profile from trash. If previous name is taken, profile will be restored alongside as "name (2)" — nothing gets overwritten.
name: restore_profile
